data.gender_notes: Niranjan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Niranjan is recorded with the meaning “Innocent, Pure”. Niranjan is a Hindu name meaning “Innocent, Pure”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: निरन्जन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Absence of any imperfection or impurity, free from any flaw, blemish or stain.

in_hindi.name: निरन्जन
in_hindi.meaning: निर् - निर्बेस्कार (absence of impurity) जनन - जनना (birth)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Absence of impurity at the time of birth, pure birth.

in_marathi.name: Niranjan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niranjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One whose vision is pure and free from worldly desires and impurities.

in_bengali.name: Niranjan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Innocent, Pure
in_bengali.long_meaning: Niranjan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One whose vision is pure and free from worldly desires and impurities.
